name: Recognition Processing State Machine V3.1
supersedes: Recognition_State_Timeline_Spec_V1_3 as effective Page Contract timeline

states.visual_behavior: Original photo is immediately visible and unchanged. Use the existing IMAGE_RECOGNIZING Early reference and Frozen copy: title 正在准备识别; subtitle AI 已获取这张照片. No fish focus is implied.
states.transition_rule: Enter when a normalized image is accepted. Advance to DETECTING only after both the 220ms minimum beat and the real detection-start event; remain here while either condition is missing. A real pipeline failure exits to TECHNICAL_FAILURE.

states.visual_behavior: Keep the original photo dominant. Use the existing IMAGE_RECOGNIZING Late reference and Frozen copy: title 正在理解这张照片; subtitle 寻找这次鱼获的线索. No bbox, halo or contour before a real focus.
states.transition_rule: Advance to OUTLINE only after both the 320ms minimum beat and a real classifier-eligible fish focus. A real NO_FISH/quality issue follows its existing Result recovery route; a reported exception follows TECHNICAL_FAILURE. No timer-only advance.

states.visual_behavior: Use the existing FISH_LOCATED reference and Frozen copy: title 已定位到鱼体; subtitle 正在分析这次鱼获. Show focus/contour only from real detector geometry.
states.transition_rule: Advance to CLASSIFYING only after both the 350ms minimum beat and a real classification-start event. If focus/crop is lost or an actual failure is reported, use the existing issue/TECHNICAL_FAILURE route.

states.visual_behavior: Use the existing SPECIES_RECOGNIZING reference and Frozen copy: title 正在认识这条鱼; subtitle 分析鱼体特征. The subtitle role maps to type.body_small.
states.transition_rule: Advance to RESULT_READY only after both the 250ms minimum beat and a real classifier result. A real model/dependency failure routes to TECHNICAL_FAILURE. Do not create an ETA, percentage or timer-only completion.

states.visual_behavior: No additional Processing page state or artwork; hand the real Recognition outcome to Recognition Result.
states.transition_rule: Terminal handoff to recognition.result.v3_1 immediately when CLASSIFYING has met its minimum beat and the pipeline has produced its result.

failure_routing.no_fish: Distinct NO_FISH recovery; never relabel as a technical failure.
failure_routing.image_quality: Distinct IMAGE_QUALITY_WARNING recovery only when the real quality gate emits INVALID.
failure_routing.technical_failure: Only a reported pipeline/model/crop/network dependency failure; never show No Fish/Image Quality copy.

timing_policy: Durations are minimum visual beats for each named state; real event completion and minimum duration must both be satisfied. They are not promised total recognition time, progress percentages, ETA, or permission to auto-advance.
